rewrite.title: Rewrite commits
rewrite.rangeHint: from the selected commit to HEAD

rewrite.note: Squashed messages are concatenated; dropped content disappears with the snapshot.

bisect.resetConfirm: This ends the bisect session and restores the original branch. Continue?
